interpretation.improved: Severity, source, action, provenance and generated field labels use sentence case consistently; financial acronyms retain uppercase spelling.
interpretation.regressions: None detected by the existing backend and browser suites. No retrieval or finance changes.
interpretation.tradeoff: A shared presentation helper replaces inconsistent inline and CSS casing. Worth the small addition for consistency across Data, Compare and detail panels.
interpretation.limits: Presentation regression checks, not a retrieval-quality measurement. The initial browser run used the existing API server and lacked the bundled browser; the successful run used an isolated mock server and installed Chrome.
